digest.component_or_area: completion verifier budget and verdict caching
propositions: Budget exhaustion on legitimate criteria causes false FAIL verdicts because defaults (8 steps/criterion, 48 floor) are calibrated to story tasks but epic criteria traverse children at 5-10 requests each with no evidence-surface scaling
Re-verification cycles re-prove all criteria repeatedly because no cross-run cache exists for validated PASS verdicts, costing ~10 min per re-verify cycle even when criteria remain valid
Small budget clamp adds false negatives without safety benefit since runaway is already guarded separately by tool_calls_limit and loop detection

Ref-targeted verification (for drift checks and stacked flows) must bind verdict fingerprints to the verified commit's blob SHAs, not HEAD's, or cached verdicts become invalid if HEAD advances without content change
Seeded cached verdicts must bypass finalizer re-judgment and preserve same-run downgrades, preventing cache entries from being contradicted by transient finalizer state within a run
